facts.fact: The Interior Ministry's DAF head said on 2026-09-24 that an amending text, after committee work at the National Assembly, was to extend validity of the 2016 ECOWAS biometric cards; the article calls the instrument being amended a decree, and the date is the story's.
facts.system: décret régissant les cartes d'identité biométriques CEDEAO
